title: The Locked Bookshop
motive_summary: Priya killed Isabella after Isabella discovered that Priya had forged her signature on the bookshop expansion documents to accelerate her inheritance of the partnership after Marcus's death.
overview_text: 09:15 — Isabella Reed, owner of Reed & Bell Bookshop, found dead in the bookshop back room by Nadia Cole. The back door was ajar and a window pane was broken — staged to suggest a break-in. Several villagers passed the bookshop between 08:30 and 09:00. The morning can be rewound from 06:30.
